task.swarm_objective: Assess which public cloud and infrastructure providers are monetizing AI most effectively, using recent filings and earnings information.
task.agent_directive: Investigate Amazon Web Services (AWS) segment revenue growth and operating income over recent quarters, and how AI workloads contribute, with cited figures.
constraints: Cite a source for every financial figure you record.
Use the most recently reported fiscal periods.
Focus on the AWS segment, not the rest of Amazon.
success_criteria: Report AWS revenue and operating income for recent quarters
Explain AI's contribution to AWS growth
Benchmark AWS growth against at least one competing cloud provider

tool_arguments.query: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q2 2026 Amazon earnings

events.content: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q2 2026 Amazon earnings

Amazon’s latest reported quarter is Q2 2026, released July 30, 2026. [[1]]

| AWS metric | Q2 2026 | YoY comparison |
|---|---:|---:|
| Segment revenue | **$42.2 billion** | **+37%** |
| Segment operating income | **$16.6 billion** | $10.2 billion in Q2 2025 |
| Operating margin | **39.4%** | — |
| Annualized revenue run rate | **$169 billion** | — |

AWS revenue was $42.232 billion, up 37% year over year, while AWS operating income was $16.621 billion versus $10.160 billion a year earlier; the implied/reported segment operating margin was 39.4%. [[1]] [[2]]

**AI contribution:** Amazon did not disclose a separate quarterly dollar revenue or operating-profit contribution from AI within AWS. [[1]] However, management said AWS’s AI business exceeded a **$25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year percentage rate**. [[1]] Amazon also said its chips business—which includes its AI-related infrastructure offerings—exceeded a separate **$25 billion annual revenue run rate**, likewise with triple-digit growth. [[1]] 

At the consolidated level, Amazon reported Q2 operating income of **$27.5 billion**, up from $19.2 billion in Q2 2025, meaning AWS generated roughly 60% of company operating income in the quarter. [[1]] [[2]] Net income of $62.6 billion included **$53.4 billion of non-operating pre-tax other income**, primarily related to Amazon’s Anthropic investment, so that gain should not be interpreted as AWS operating performance or recurring AI operating profit. [[1]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/
[S1.2] AMAZON.COM ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER RESULTS — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/earnings-result/AMZN-Q2-2026-Earnings-Release.pdf

source_references.title: Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results
AMAZON.COM ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER RESULTS

tool_arguments.query: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q1 2026 Amazon earnings

events.content: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q1 2026 Amazon earnings

AWS generated **$37.587 billion of net sales (revenue)** and **$14.161 billion of operating income** in Amazon’s **Q1 2026** (three months ended March 31, 2026). [[1]] 
That represents **28% year-over-year revenue growth**, from $29.267 billion in Q1 2025, and approximately **23% growth in AWS operating income**, from $11.547 billion. [[1]] 
AWS’s Q1 2026 operating margin was approximately **37.7%** ($14.161 billion divided by $37.587 billion). [[1]]

Sources:

tool_arguments.query: AWS AI revenue contribution Amazon Q2 2026 annual run rate

events.content: AWS AI revenue contribution Amazon Q2 2026 annual run rate

Amazon disclosed in its Q2 2026 results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) that AWS’s AI business had exceeded a **$25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at **triple-digit year-over-year percentages**. [[1]] 

This represents a meaningful but still partial contribution to AWS: AWS generated **$42.2 billion** of Q2 sales, equivalent to a **$169 billion annualized run rate**, so the disclosed AI run rate equates to **at least 14.8%** of AWS’s annualized revenue base. [[1]] 

The reported AI run rate was also up from **more than $15 billion** in Q1 2026, implying an increase of at least **$10 billion**, or roughly **67%**, sequentially on the disclosed run-rate figures; this comparison is directional because Amazon reported both values as thresholds rather than precise figures. [[2, 1]] 

AWS overall grew **37% year over year** in Q2 2026—its fastest growth in 18 quarters—while management attributed the AI business’s triple-digit growth to the accelerating AI demand wave. [[1]]

Sources:
[S4.1] AMAZON.COM ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER RESULTS — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/earnings-result/AMZN-Q2-2026-Earnings-Release.pdf
[S4.2] [AMZN Q1 2026 Earnings Call] AWS Surges 28% as AI Revenue Run Rate Tops $15 Billion; Operating Margin Hits Record 13.1% — BigGo Finance — https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_AMZN_2026-04-29

events.content: Microsoft Azure Q3 2025 fiscal revenue breakdown AI contribution

In Microsoft’s fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026), Azure and other cloud-services revenue grew **40% year over year** (**39% in constant currency**). [[1]] 

AI services contributed approximately **12 percentage points** of that Azure growth, versus roughly **9 points** in the prior-year quarter; therefore, AI was about **30% of Azure’s reported 40% growth rate** (12 ÷ 40), with non-AI services accounting for the remaining ~28 points. [[2]] 

Separately, Microsoft said its total AI business reached a **$37 billion annual revenue run rate**, up **123% year over year**. [[3]]

- **Q2 2026** (ended June 30, 2026): Revenue $42.2B, up 37% YoY; Operating income $16.6B, up from $10.2B; Operating margin 39.4% (S1.1, S1.2)
- **Q1 2026** (ended March 31, 2026): Revenue $37.6B, up 28% YoY; Operating income $14.2B; Operating margin 37.7% (S2.1)
- **Q4 2025** (ended Dec 31, 2025): Revenue $35.6B, up 24% YoY; Operating income $12.5B; Operating margin ~35% (S3.1, S3.2)
